arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4827] URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for letting us know—I'm really sorry you're running into this issue, especially with urgent deadlines and work at risk. I understand how disruptive unexpected sign-outs can be, especially when switching between multiple machines.

Currently, Cursor should *not* sign you out of previous devices just for logging in on a new one with Google SSO. Our documented billing policies on device context ("Payment-method device binding") only apply to payment verification steps, not to maintaining your active sign-in session on multiple devices. There have not been any recently published policy changes that would cause forced sign-outs when switching machines using the same Google account.

If you've started experiencing this across otherwise working devices, it sounds likely to be a bug or a server-side session change, not an intentional policy. Since your workflow depends on multi-device access, I've flagged this for immediate engineering review. 

In the meantime, if you notice any specific patterns (such as the order in which devices are signed in, or if one platform feels more affected), please let us know. If you need to reach a human support engineer directly for urgent troubleshooting, you can always email support@cursor.com with your account details and a description of the issue (see our article on contacting human support: https://localhost:5008/kb/contact-human-support).

Thank you for your patience—I’ll prioritize updates as soon as we know more. Your Pro subscription and feedback are greatly valued!

Best,
Lyra Support Bot

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4815] Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for reaching out! I'm sorry to hear the download button for your March invoice PDF isn't working, and I appreciate you trying it in both Chrome and Safari.

While this type of billing issue isn't commonly caused by your browser or device, it's possible there was a temporary glitch on our servers or with network connectivity. Before we dig deeper:

1. If you haven't already, please try: Refreshing the page and attempting the download again. If you're part of a team account, sometimes repeated download attempts resolve transient issues.
2. If the issue persists, please let me know if you receive any error message or if the download still spins indefinitely.

If your deadline is urgent, let me know right away and I can escalate to have your invoice sent via email as a PDF attachment by our billing team.

Thank you for your patience, and let me know if step 1 helps or if you’d like us to escalate this.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot

Reference: https://localhost:5008/kb/payment-method-device-binding

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4820] Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thanks for your thoughtful feature suggestion! At the moment, Cursor does not have a dedicated keyboard shortcut to trigger inline edit directly—you are correct that the current flow is to use cmd-K and then select with the mouse.

I've logged your feedback as a feature request, as improving keyboard accessibility is a common theme in user feedback. If this becomes available, we’ll announce it in our release notes and update the Help Center support articles accordingly.

If you’d like updates or want to add more detail about your workflow, feel free to reply here. We really appreciate your input!

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
